colors.$doc: The only three brand colours — the ULARA «Parchment & Royal» palette (paper #F5F1E8 · ink #1A1713 · royal #2540D9), pinned to shared/design-tokens.json color.brand (the 2026 takeover re-valued the trio from «Parchment & Sienna»: ink #262019 → #1A1713, sienna #C43E16 → royal #2540D9); the generator cross-checks this trio against design-tokens.json on every run.
